# Amazon Redshift

Store provisioned cluster, subnet group and parameter group metadata without running a warehouse.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `redshift` |
| Signing name | `redshift` |
| Wire protocol | AWS Query |
| API version | `2012-12-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 14 of 145 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-redshift) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No SQL, database runtime, JDBC/ODBC listener, Redshift Data API or Redshift Serverless; advertised endpoints are metadata only.
- No snapshots, restore, pause/resume/reboot/resize, logging, usage limits, IAM role association, datashares or scheduled actions.
- DeleteCluster requires SkipFinalClusterSnapshot=true; final snapshot requests fail explicitly.
- ModifyCluster excludes resize and rename inputs; CloudFormation rejects resize changes, while immutable identity/database/subnet changes use replacement.
- No parameter values: ModifyClusterParameterGroup, DescribeClusterParameters and ResetClusterParameterGroup are excluded; CloudFormation rejects non-empty Parameters.
- Describe tag-key/value filters are excluded; DescribeTags supports resource name/type and Marker/MaxRecords only.
- VPC security group IDs are format-validated metadata; EC2 security group existence and runtime network provisioning are excluded.
- Automated snapshot retention and encryption fields are metadata only; the built-in default parameter group and its tags are immutable.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.
